description: How TmFacetFilter presents its groups: the default trigger with an overlay (anchored dialog popover on a wide layout, bottom sheet on a phone), or the groups inline in the page flow.

members.name: Popover
members.description: A trigger button opens the groups in an overlay: an anchored dialog popover on a wide layout, a bottom sheet on a mobile one. The default — the groups cost no page space until the user asks for them.

members.name: Inline
members.description: The groups are rendered in the page flow, always visible, with no trigger and no overlay — for a filter sidebar where the groups ARE the content. The mobile sheet does not apply, because there is nothing to open.
